notes.title: Adding various features to improve user experience
notes.content:
Hello! Here is what has been added to the game with this patch:
- Added Sound Options menu when in mission.
- Added a brief auto explanation of controls that pops-up at the beginning of the first mission.
- Added menu option that explains briefly what each exterminator' skills are. 
- Added retro roughness look
- Moved some spawns that where annoying where they were...
- Minor change on Ghoulraiders' AI.

notes.title: Addicted to game adjustments!
notes.content:
Hello all,
it seems I'm just addicted to changing small things in the game over and over... 
So, here is what changed:
- Fleshbags: Fleshbulbs take much less time to mutate. But now it takes longer for bigger Fleshbags specimen to mutate. Also, bigger forms spawn less Fleshbulbs when hit.
- Ghoulraiders: they can no longer go into berserk mode if they lose eye contact with their target. Apparently it was a frustrating race feature... But now Ghoulraiders armed with automatic energy weapons are more stubborn and will shoot at the walls trying to kill the player.
- Endgame bonus: reduced the bonus points awarded for the exterminators that survived.

notes.title: Will the best exterminator please stand up?
notes.content:
Hello Exterminators!
With this new big update a lot of new feature are added up for Chaos Brigade, some that new players will find usefull, some the the more experienced exterminators in the galaxy!

- [b]Leaderboard[/b]: finally you can climp the ladder for the title of the Best Exterminator! Challenge players all over planet Earth to become the #1 Chaos Brigade player.

- [b]Added Mouse and Keyboards control[/b]! Finally those of you who prefer to play via standard controls can do so! Even more, the game has a completely different feel when played via mouse and keys, so even joypad players might will to enjoy it.

- [b]Difficulty Revised[/b]: the game has been made a little easier:
[list] You now begin the game with 20 bitcoins, so you will never face that nasty Game Over screen if you suc... aehm, should you fail your first missions...[/list]
[list] All exterminators got a health increase of 15-20%[/list]
[list] All enemies have 10% less health[/list]

- [b]Gameplay Experience Updated[/b]:
[list] Magmor improved his shield: it can wipe out fires as he moves.[/list]
[list] Muerto can fire more grenades! Well, he can also destroy ship faster, but hey![/list]
[list] Ghoulraider Commander will not go in berserk anymore...[/list]
[list] Some achievements were made more easy to complete...[/list]
[list] Extended character's description can be accessed at the Archives.[/list]

- Minor Graphical Improvements

- Minor Bugs removed.

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0
notes.content:
Hello! This small hotfix resolves acouple minor issue and improves the behaviour of the aiming mechanic.

- Aim improved even more: you can aim even if the exterminator is not on the ground. Also, the ability is more snappy, for increased action vibes.
- Fixed a wrongly positioned tile on Core Mining Corps medium class spaceships.
- Fixed a bug that prevented one of the simplest achievements in the game to be completed.
